title: Training-cut ownership
openingNarrative: Decide with Rohan how the shortened training package may use his story. Dropping access, delirium, restraint, school, home staffing, and privacy from the cut is a framing choice — not a clinical outcome.
clinicalState: Dialogue window. Authorship and privacy domains active.

choices.label: Withdraw permission for Rohan’s name on the shortened cut
choices.immediateConsequence: Authorship control rises; ethical training trust rises.
choices.delayedConsequence: Dispute may remain over what anonymous mechanics may still teach.
choices.rohanAacLine: NOW ASK ME WHAT HAPPENS NEXT.

choices.label: Allow anonymous mechanics teaching without identity or voice
choices.immediateConsequence: Partial compromise; privacy holds better than full likeness use.
choices.delayedConsequence: Symptom-language misuse must still be blocked.

choices.label: Approve name, voice, and likeness for wider distribution now
choices.immediateConsequence: Reach rises; authorship and privacy fall without granular consent.
choices.delayedConsequence: Hard to claw back once released.

disabilityRightsNotes: Lived-experience training requires ongoing consent, not a one-time spectacle release.
debriefNotes: Authorship beat closes into season reflection — not a walking or airway-removal victory.
